newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia supermarket to issue 300 bln pesos bonds.
newsitem.headline: Colombia supermarket to issue 300 bln pesos bonds.

text.p: BOGOTA, Aug 19 Reuter - Colombian supermarket chain Almacenes Exito will issue 30 billion pesos ($26.3 million) in bonds to the domestic market, the Suvalor brokerage said Tuesday.

Suvalor, which will be handling the issue, said the paper would be floating interest bonds but did not say when they would be issued nor for what period. The bonds will be negotiable on the Medellin and Bogota markets.
Exito, among Colombia's five largest supermarket chains, aims to invest $200 million in its operations between now and the year 2000.
